name: Send Microsoft 365 update digest via email with GPT-4o-mini

parameters.content:
## 📋 Send Microsoft 365 update digest via email with GPT-4o-mini

**Who's it for**
IT admins, M365 administrators, and helpdesk teams who need to stay on top of Microsoft 365 changes without manually checking multiple blogs every day.

**What it does / How it works**
This workflow runs every morning and checks the official Microsoft Tech Community blogs for the M365 core service, Security & Compliance, and Teams/Roadmap boards. It pulls the latest posts from each RSS feed, keeps only items published in the last 24 hours, and removes duplicate titles across the three feeds. If new items are found, it bundles them into a single text block and sends it to GPT-4o-mini, which scores each update by priority (Critical/High/Medium/Low), category, and whether action is required, then writes a clean HTML summary. That summary is emailed to your IT team. If nothing new was published, a short "no updates" email is sent instead, so you always know the workflow ran.

**How to set up**
1. Add an OpenAI credential (HTTP Header Auth, `Authorization: Bearer sk-...`) to the GPT-4o-mini node.
2. Add an SMTP credential to both email nodes.
3. Update the `fromEmail` and `toEmail` fields to your own addresses.
4. Confirm the RSS URLs below are still valid — Microsoft has changed TechCommunity feed paths before.

**Requirements**
- An OpenAI API key with access to GPT-4o-mini
- An SMTP account for sending email

**How to customize**
- Change the schedule trigger to run at a different time.
- Add or remove RSS feed sources to track other Microsoft blogs.
- Edit the GPT-4o-mini system prompt to change the prioritization logic or HTML layout.

⏰ **Trigger**
Runs every day at 07:00.
Edit the cron expression to change the schedule.

📡 **Fetch RSS Feeds**
Pulls the latest posts from 3 official Microsoft Tech Community boards in parallel:
• M365 Blog
• Security & Compliance
• Teams / Roadmap

🔍 **Parse & Deduplicate**
Extracts each RSS item, keeps only posts from the last 24h, and removes duplicate titles across the 3 feeds.

❓ **Any New Items?**
No new posts → fallback email.
New posts found → continue to AI analysis.

**No Updates – Fallback**
Sent only when nothing new was published in the last 24 hours.

🧩 **Aggregate**
Formats every item into a single numbered text block ready to hand to the AI model.

🤖 **AI Triage (GPT-4o-mini)**
Scores each update — Priority, Category, Action Required, IT Impact — and writes the HTML email body.

⚠️ Needs an OpenAI API key (HTTP Header Auth credential).

📧 **Send Digest**
Delivers the final HTML email via SMTP.
⚠️ Needs an SMTP credential + updated from/to addresses.

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "gpt-4o-mini",
  "temperature": 0.2,
  "max_tokens": 3000,
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "system",
      "content": "You are an IT analyst specializing in Microsoft 365. Analyze M365 updates and produce a structured daily digest for the IT team.

For each update assess:
- Priority: CRITICAL / HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW
- Category: Security | Compliance | Feature Change | Deprecation | New Feature | Maintenance
- Action Required: Yes / No
- Brief IT Impact (1 sentence)

Produce a clean HTML email body with:
1. Summary header with date and total count
2. CRITICAL/HIGH section highlighted in red/orange (if any)
3. MEDIUM/LOW section
4. Each item: Title, Priority badge, Category, Action Required, Impact, Link

Use inline CSS only. Return ONLY the HTML body content, no <html> or <body> tags."
    },
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "Analyze these {{ $json.itemCount }} Microsoft 365 updates from the last 24 hours and produce the HTML digest:

{{ $json.formattedItems }}"
    }
  ]
}
